iran_nuclear.name: Iran Nuclear
iran_nuclear.notes: Day 63. FALLING: Trump says Iran agreed to hand over enriched uranium 'nuclear dust' and sides are 'close' to deal. However enrichment freeze talks still stalled - US demands 20-year suspension, Iran offers 5-year. Iran FM says enrichment right 'indisputable' but level 'negotiable'. IAEA locked out 8+ months. 440kg 60% uranium location unknown. NPT Review Conference starts Apr 27. Polymarket: 36% enrichment agreement by Apr 30, 15.5% peace deal by Apr 22, 61.5% by May 31. Oil ~$102. Probability 38%. Falling.

iran_conventional.name: Iran Conventional
iran_conventional.notes: Day 63. FALLING: Blockade Day 7. Trump says war 'close to over'. Iran agrees to hand over enriched uranium. 2nd round talks under discussion. Qatar hosting talks - Pakistan PM in Doha. France/UK planning Hormuz conference. Iran threatens Red Sea/Gulf shipping retaliation. Iranian aide threatens to sink US ships if Trump 'polices' Hormuz. Oil Brent ~$102. Senate Republicans block Dem effort to end war. China FM: Hormuz reopening 'international demand.' Ceasefire deadline Apr 22 - 5 days. Diplomatic momentum building. Probability 55%. Falling.

israel_lebanon.name: Israel-Lebanon
israel_lebanon.notes: Day 63. FALLING: Trump-brokered 10-day ceasefire in effect. Netanyahu confirmed. Rubio hosted first high-level meeting in DC. Hezbollah NOT part of agreement - demands no freedom of movement for Israeli forces. Netanyahu says troops remain in Lebanon. Hezbollah claims right to resist. PBS: ceasefire driven by Trump request to support US-Iran negotiations. Lebanon ceasefire could lead to Iran talks breakthrough. 1M+ displaced. Probability 18%. Falling.

turkey.name: Turkey
turkey.notes: STABLE: Roketsan TAYFUN Block-4 hypersonic missile (Mach-5, 1000km range) entering mass production 2026. Largest defense investment in Republic history ($3B). 300 ER air-launched ballistic missile test planned. Defense spending up 30% to $27.34B. Largest integrated air defense facility in Europe. Pushing EU defense integration. Probability 5%. Stable.

india.name: India-Pakistan
india.notes: STABLE: CFR 2026 survey warns India-Pakistan armed conflict likely - Tier II risk. Drivers intact - terrorism from Pakistan. 2025 Operation Sindoor precedent. Pakistan PM Sharif in Qatar mediating Iran ceasefire. No new escalations. Probability 6%. Stable.

russia.name: Russia (Nuclear Signaling)
russia.notes: Day 66. RISING: First of 64 Finnish F-35A nuclear-capable jets arriving 2026. Finland nuclear weapons vote pending in parliament - right-wing coalition holds majority. Kremlin: Finland 'will pose threat, force countermeasures.' Medvedev: Finland/Sweden 'automatic targets.' Finnish professor warns Finland could be first hit in NATO-Russia war. Danish intel: Russia ready for localized war vs neighbor in 6 months if Ukraine stops. Last US-Russia nuclear pact expired Feb 2026. Probability 18%. Rising.

china.name: China
china.notes: STABLE: Taiwan tracking 3 PLA aircraft + 9 ships as of Apr 16. Naval surge beyond typical 50-60 ships continues. Xi met KMT Cheng Li-wun - 'absolutely not tolerate' independence. US re-evaluating threat level - 2026 DoD report says 'steady but uneven progress'. Taiwan drawing strategic lessons from Iran war. Chinese tanker transited Hormuz despite blockade. $14B US arms for Taiwan. Taiwan military drills for energy routes. Confidence in US support waning. Probability 35%. Stable.

north_korea.name: North Korea
north_korea.notes: Day 62. SUSTAINED: Kim oversaw 5-missile test from Choe Hyon destroyer Apr 12 - 2 cruise + 3 anti-ship. Third destroyer test round in 6 weeks. ICBM engine test for US-mainland-capable missile (Mar 29). Constitutional nuclear status irreversible. ODNI confirms full US mainland ICBM range. 4th destroyer under construction. Probability 10%. Stable.

russia_ukraine.name: Russia-Ukraine
russia_ukraine.notes: War Year 4, Day 1167+. STABLE-HIGH: Russia launched deadliest aerial attack of 2026 on Apr 16 - 17 killed, 100+ wounded. Kyiv hit with ballistic missiles. Ukraine drone strikes devastating Russian oil infrastructure - Baltic ports Primorsk/Ust-Luga hard hit, Crimea Feodosia terminal destroyed. Germany invests €300M in Ukrainian long-range strike. Russia warns Europe against funding drone production. Russia crude exports from Black Sea limited. Patriot shortage critical - systems diverted to Iran theater. IISS: 'escalation, not stalemate.' Russia intensifying sabotage in Europe. Probability 85%. Stable.

pakistan_afghanistan.name: Pakistan-Afghanistan
pakistan_afghanistan.notes: STABLE: China-mediated ceasefire talks in Urumqi concluded 2nd round - agreed not to escalate. Fighting worst since Taliban 2021. Temporary Eid ceasefire collapsed. Pakistan operations against TTP continue. UN experts urge lasting peace. CSIS analysis: Pakistan declared 'open war' against Taliban. PM Sharif in Qatar for regional diplomacy. Probability 7%. Stable.
